summary: Researched all seven Phase 8 work items plus the three folded-in revisions, with live measurement at HEAD 657c41892. The decisive finding: collapsing the root activates Mathlib's linter.style.header on all 503 modules at once (it gates on direct import from ./FormalSystem.lean, so it is currently live on exactly one), surfacing 22 latent findings under CI's existing --wfail.

artifacts.summary: Feasibility and cost of the mk_all root collapse, the C6 manifest burndown, mk_all/lint-style CI adoption, the release workflow and the publication gate, with measured linter debt at HEAD.

user_decision.question: Adopting lint-style-action surfaces 258 'unicode character not on the allowlist' findings across the library's own notation (the limit-closure diamond, vector arrows, biconditional arrows). Mathlib's allowlist is Mathlib-specific and this notation is documented and load-bearing, so how should the unicode text linter be handled?
options: Disable linter.unicodeLinter in lakefile.toml [leanOptions] with a recorded reason, and adopt every other lint-style text linter
Seed scripts/nolints-style.txt with per-file exceptions for all 258 findings, keeping the linter nominally on
Defer lint-style-action adoption entirely until the notation set is reconciled with Mathlib's allowlist upstream
user_decision.recommended: Disable linter.unicodeLinter in lakefile.toml [leanOptions] with a recorded reason, and adopt every other lint-style text linter
